column1: # RE-MEASURE THE FOUR win32-x64 FULL-DISK ROWS AGAINST A POST-REPAIR BINARY.
# WHY THESE FOUR, AND WHY NOW. Their `write: "disk"` rows were all minted by the
# 2026-07-31/08-01 win32 sweeps on nub v0.6.0 -- `grant-matrix-win32-x64.ndjson`,
# `-fixedfloor` and `-tier2`. `50ec17043a` (2026-08-05) landed AFTER every one of them,
# and it repairs a defect that hit this exact family: the container profile was not a
# leaf of the ancestor chain, so the intermediate `…\AppData\Local\Packages` carried no
# ace for the container and `realpathSync(os.tmpdir())` died `EPERM` -- which `temp-dir`
# calls AT MODULE LOAD, under `tempfile` -> `download`/`decompress` ->
# `bin-build`/`bin-wrapper`. Every rung below `fullDisk` failed for them, and `fullDisk`
# passed only because that rung declines the LowBox token altogether. So the rows are
# stale by construction and have never been re-measured.
# THE PRE-REPAIR ROWS ARE THE RED ARM. Each target below has a committed v0.6.0 record
# whose verdict is NEEDS-FULL-DISK (or CONTROL-FAILED). Versions are pinned to exactly
# what those runs measured, and `tree-sitter-kotlin` keeps its `git-repo` capability,
# so a verdict that moves is attributable to the repair and not to a different fixture.
# THE FIRST THREE ROWS ARE THE POSITIVE CONTROL AND THEY ARE PINNED -- the Verdict step
# requires these exact name/version pairs and discards the whole run if any fails its
# `no_grants` cell. Each is a bare node-gyp compile committed as NEEDS-NOTHING on
# win32-x64, so a pass proves node-gyp reached Python and MSVC from INSIDE the jail with
# no grants, and a toolchain-shaped failure on any target row is that package's property
# rather than the host's.
